text:
harper: hey infra — first Buildkite run on my onboarding branch is failing on the test step. logs show a missing env var "REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY". who should I ping to get the project secret or a temp key? cc @sam

sam: hey harper — can you paste the build link and a short log snippet? probable missing env in pipeline settings.

harper: https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding-samples/builds/42

harper: ```
$ ./scripts/run-tests.sh
INFO: starting test matrix
ERROR: Missing required env: REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY
FATAL: Exiting with status 1
```

sam: ok, that explains it. onboarding-samples uses a masked pipeline env var called REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY stored in the repo settings (Buildkite -> Pipelines -> Environment). new accounts can't see masked values unless added to project. which repo/organization?

harper: org: infra, repo: onboarding-samples (the one from the quickstart)

sam: got it. quick fix: I can add a placeholder key scoped to this pipeline so your build can proceed. longer term we prefer using the Vault/OIDC setup so we don't store long-lived keys in pipeline envs. is it ok if I add a temporary placeholder now?
harper: yes please — that'll unblock me :thumbsup:

sam: done — added REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY=onboard-temp-xxx (masked). re-running build now.

ci-bot: Build #42 (branch: harper/onboard) started by sam — https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding-samples/builds/42/jobs/123

ci-bot: Job test-run: step started

ci-bot: Job test-run: step passed (exit 0) — 28s

harper: awesome, tests passed. thanks!

sam: nice. follow-ups: 1) I'll add a short note to the onboarding doc about requesting pipeline secrets (who to ping and expected SLA). 2) we'll kick off a PR to replace the masked pipeline env with an OIDC role so new hires don't need manual ops help long term.

kate: added a blurb to the onboarding doc: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/ci.md — explains where to find pipeline envs and the request process.

harper: perfect. marking this done for me. thanks all :party_parrot:
